title: 16p11.2 microdeletion enhances gene expression variability between human iPSC-derived forebrain interneuron progenitor cells in culture.
abstract: Isogenic iPSC interneuron progenitors with heterozygous 16p11.2 microdeletion show significantly greater cell-to-cell transcript variability across regulons and random gene sets; most-variable regulons enriched for cell-cycle genes regulated by autism/obesity-associated TFs.
